description: This source file defines an abstract controller class for handling REST API requests within the OrangeHRM installer module. It provides a common pattern for handling different HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and managing responses and error handling. The class is intended to be extended by concrete controllers that implement specific request handling logic.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing a template for handling RESTful HTTP requests in the installer module, with built-in error handling and response formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes the incoming HTTP request based on its method, handles JSON content, manages exceptions, and returns a JSON response.
